title: Using Read Scale-Out for Better Performance

facts.text: Read scale-out isolates analytical read-only workloads from business process read-write transactions to prevent performance degradation.
Read scale-out uses a read-only replica of the database instead of the primary read-write database for reports, queries, and API pages.
In Business Central Online, read scale-out is readily available and automatically enabled on databases.
Developers can set default database access intent on reports and query objects using the DataAccessIntent property.
Read-only intent can be enabled on OData GET requests by configuring the Enable Read-Only Intent on GET Requests server setting.
Read scale-out cannot be enabled on sandbox environments; read-only objects only access the primary database.
Using read scale-out may introduce a slight delay when reading data due to replication lag from primary to secondary replicas.
